value.rationale: A natural infinite family of triangle-frustrated classical spin systems exhibits a universal exact one-third plateau whose endpoints and full configuration sets depend on a structural graph matching hypothesis. Two distinct physically interpretable critical configurational entropies and connectivity classes are completely computed for the canonical truncated tetrahedron; the result is not a mere restatement of one local inequality or a finite toy numerical census.
